generic_domain.justification: Communication efficiency is the more encompassing term that refers to improving how data or information is transmitted and received, which includes but isn't limited to communication optimization. Communication efficiency addresses not only optimizing certain aspects of communication but also reducing resource usage, minimizing latency, enhancing throughput—all of which could fall under optimization. Thus, 'communication efficiency' is selected as it provides a comprehensive framework that includes various methods and strategies aimed at optimizing communication while focusing on resource utilization in deep learning contexts.
